# Vulnerabilities that `make vulncheck` reports without failing
# (scripts/govulncheck-gate.py). One entry per line: <OSV ID> <justification>.
# Remove an entry as soon as a fixed release can be adopted; the gate prints a
# notice when an allowed vulnerability is no longer called.

GO-2026-6278 gorilla/websocket v1.5.3 regressed from crypto/rand to math/rand for client frame mask keys (v1.5.1 and v1.5.2 are unaffected, but cometbft, oasis-core and gosec require v1.5.3, so no downgrade is possible). The mask carries no confidentiality (the key is sent in the frame); it only protects WebSocket-unaware intercepting proxies from cache poisoning by attacker-chosen client payloads, and since Go 1.22 top-level math/rand draws from the runtime's ChaCha8 generator. Only Tenderdash's WebSocket client (rpc/jsonrpc/client) masks; the node's WebSocket server does not. The fix exists only as an untagged master pseudo-version (v1.5.4-0.20240701034025-d67f41855da4). Revisit when gorilla/websocket tags a fixed release.
